findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: invoice_match · Private data: sql_preflight, invoice_match · Public sink: payout_preflight · Destructive: sql_preflight, invoice_match, package_install_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: invoice_match · Private data: sql_preflight, invoice_match · Public sink: payout_preflight · Destructive: sql_preflight, invoice_match, package_install_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
